newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.25 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Tuesday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money market at 3.25 percent, dealers said.
The central bank intervened to add liquidity to the market after the call loan or overnight lending rate was bid at 3.25 percent, the top of the Bank of Canada's target range for the rate.
With the move the Bank of Canada confirmed its desire to maintain the range and keep its interest rate policy on hold.
"It's just tight, just like yesterday, it just got tight in the afternoon," said a T-bill dealer with one bank-owned brokerage.
The three-month cash T-bill traded with a yield of 3.20 percent in the wake of the move, while the three-month when-issued T-bill traded with a yield of 3.25 percent.
